hints.title: Character Classification
hints.text: For each character, check if it is an English vowel or consonant.

hints.title: Score Weights
hints.text: Add 2 points for vowels and subtract 1 point for consonants.

hints.title: Accumulate Over String
hints.text: Sum the scores across all characters in the string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean membership check and score accumulation.
